topic: How can Product Owner's sk-create-figjam packet and its integration with sk-product-owner improve, judged against the public FigJam work online? The packet turns screenshots, Figma flows and product docs into a checked Mermaid model of one of seven types (user flow, process, architecture, sequence, state, ER, gantt) and writes it to FigJam through the hosted Figma MCP generate_diagram tool, with figma-ds-cli fj as the Figma Desktop fallback and use_figma extensions for pins, stickies, tints and legends. Packet sources: AI Systems/Product Owner/sk-create-figjam/SKILL.md, references/flow-mode.md, references/types/*.md, references/style-guide.md, references/quality-rubric.md, references/hybrid-workflow.md, assets/flow-templates.md, assets/templates/*.md, assets/examples/*.md, scripts/flow_check.py, scripts/figjam_checks/*.py and manual-testing-playbook/ (its board quality scorecard in manual-testing-playbook.md Section 3), all under AI Systems/Product Owner/sk-create-figjam/. Integration surfaces: the hub at AI Systems/Product Owner/SKILL.md, ROUTER.md, hub-router.json, mode-registry.json and AGENTS.md; AI Systems/Product Owner/sk-product-owner/SKILL.md, references/router-contract.md, references/interactive-mode.md and references/task-mode.md; the claude.ai kernel AI Systems/Product Owner/claude project/Custom Instructions.md and its Flow Knowledge files under AI Systems/Product Owner/claude project/knowledge/; the vendored AI Systems/Product Owner/mcp-figma/SKILL.md; AI Systems/Product Owner/benchmark/hub-routing-cases.json, benchmark/gates/check_hub.py and benchmark/router/route_contract.py. The corpus is 22 public repos pinned under specs/z-staging-po-016-research/corpus/: figma__mcp-server-guide at a newer commit than phase 009 read (look for what changed, the skills-figquery folder, workflow-skills/generate-project-plan and figma-power), figma__community-resources, figma__architecture-diagram-components, openai__plugins (Figma's skills as OpenAI ships them), lightspeedwp__.github, adobe__spectrum-design-data (a design-system diagram skill), hferello__ai (arch-flow FigJam references), prasantloki__figjam-builder, rrichardsonv__parse-figjam, ecestnrkl__figjam-mcp (a board as LLM context), bluescaban__blueprints (FigJam to spec kit to Mermaid user flows), arinspunk__claude-talk-to-figma-mcp, ulasbilgen__mcp-skills-plugins (get_figjam), tmcw__figjam-mermaid, lauragalera__figjam-erd-plugin, plus the seven phase 009 repos IamTheLime__dotfiles, southleft__figma-console-mcp-skills, mkaralevich__pi-figma-labor, amo-tech-ai__rocket-path-ai, atezer__FMCP, ompug__diagram-codebase and memi-design__mermaid-jam. Half the work is the packet against the corpus: diagram types and kinds the packet lacks, model rules and checks, layout, colour and density, read-back and how a board's quality is measured, revision and fileKey reuse, extensions, failure and retry, and delivery. The other half is the integration: how a request reaches the packet and hands back, whether a Story, Epic, Doc, Task or Bug from sk-product-owner should carry or link a FigJam diagram and how, whether a board URL should reach ClickUp through the vendored mcp-click-up, how the claude.ai Project runs Flow without a Figma connector, and where the hub routing, the kernel router and the playbooks leave gaps. Name what the packet already does better than the corpus, so nothing good is removed. Never stop early: every iteration either widens the corpus (a new repo found with gh search, a new file or a new question) or deepens an earlier finding, and names the earlier iteration it builds on. Cite every claim as [SOURCE: path:line]. The synthesis ranks at least 10 improvements, at least 3 of them on the integration, each naming the Product Owner file it changes and the corpus or Product Owner file it comes from. Never open AI Systems/Product Context, any screenshot, any board URL or anything under a containment folder, and never quote Barter product flows.
